reviews.name: Caroline LSM
reviews.title: Amazing tool to skyrocket one's brand
reviews.text:
Poppy AI is a trusted tool recommended by different content creators I've been following for a long time and their journey shows how they also evolved along the way by using Poppy AI which is why I gave it a shot.

During my onboarding call, Mo helped me understand how to use it to its full potential and needless to say, navigating it on my own was nothing compared to the board his built for me. I can see how many possibilities I can do with it now and I appreciate his patience with the questions I had. 

The one thing I wish was different is that the fees were in $CAD too especially when the creators I follow are Canadians, I'm sure a lot more would be interested in this tool. I'm aware that I'll be charged more due to the conversion fees which is the only downside.

reviews.name: mbdurieux
reviews.title: Superb GenAI tool!
reviews.text: I've been using Poppy AI for several years now through a monthly subscription. There is so much to love about Poppy! In particular, as a university sociology instructor for 23 years, I can evaluate multiple journals or term papers by visually syncing them to the chat along with a complex rubric prompt, which covers: 1) complexity of thinking; 2) increasing knowledge and application of the topic or subdiscipline under study; 3) intellectual curiosity; 4) noiseless (clean and professional) communication; 5) avoidance of propaganda-like disinformation (groundless opinion). The same workflow applies to literature reviews: gathering multiple sources (or groups of sources such as academic peer-reviewed journals, websites, blogs, videos, etc.), syncing them and a "super" rubric prompt to the Poppy chat, which coordinates and directs the analysis and outputs. All of which can quickly produce a rough draft of a literature review as the basis for further polishing. Given the whiteboard experience, it's easy to sync/unsync documents as needed to evaluate, or use as analytic resources, and move them to areas indicating "current use," "someday maybe," "done with for now," etc., similar to a Kanban layout. So... when I saw the deal on Appsumo, I knew I had to take the plunge. The onboarding experience with Mohamed Elsharif was fabulous! Mo went far out of his way to help me upgrade my current account and also gave me some interesting tips I hadn't yet discovered. If you're interested in GenAI solutions, Poppy AI is worth your very serious consideration!

reviews.title: A game-changer tool and even better onboarding!
reviews.text:
We've had a really good experience with Poppy.ai so far. What really stood out to us was the onboarding process—it was a lifesaver and saved us a lot of time. Instead of having to click around and figure out the features on our own, the session ensured that everything clicked immediately.

The tool is honestly extremely useful in a variety of ways. It's unusual to find a platform that is both versatile and easy to use once you get used to it.

We'd also like to thank Mo for running the onboarding. He made sure we knew how to use them horizontally. If you want a tool that actually works (and has a team that cares about your success), look into Poppy.ai!
